'''Beast Riders''' were a specialization that [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could train in at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Riders could control various creatures such as the [[Ruping/Legends|ruping]] or a [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
